description: This file contains a class 'BitmapMesh' which is a graphics activity demonstrating bitmap mesh manipulation, including mesh construction, warping, and touch interaction within an Android application.

classes.name: BitmapMesh
classes.description: An Android activity class that showcases bitmap mesh manipulation, including warping and touch interaction.

classes.name: BitmapMesh.SampleView
classes.description: A custom View class handling mesh setup, drawing, and user interaction for bitmap warping demonstration.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: setXY
methods.description: Utility method to set x and y coordinates in a float array representing mesh points.

methods.name: SampleView
methods.description: Constructor that loads the bitmap resource, initializes mesh coordinates, and sets up transformation matrices.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles rendering of the background and bitmap mesh onto the canvas.

methods.name: warp
methods.description: Applies a warping effect to the mesh based on proximity to a touch point.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events to animate mesh warping via user interaction.
